name: @stc/constants
description: Single source of truth: routes, permissions, roles, cache tags, SEO defaults and reference data. Zero runtime dependencies.
//exports: The `./sources` subpath exists because tooling/scripts is ESM while this package is CommonJS. Importing the barrel across that boundary loses named exports: `export * from` compiles to __exportStar, which Node's cjs-module-lexer cannot resolve, so `import { SOURCE_SEEDS } from '@stc/constants'` fails at runtime. A direct subpath has no re-export chain to lose.
